name: Seobu T&D Co., Ltd.
summary: Seobu T&D Co., Ltd. engages in the tourist hotel business in South Korea. It is also involved in the new business, complex shopping mall business, hotel flex business, and logistics business, such as public freight car stop, real estate business leasing, management, storage, and oil sales business. The company was formerly known as Seobu Truck Terminal Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Seobu T&D Co., Ltd. in 2010. Seobu T&D Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
